evidence.locator: Biographical chronology and institutional historical activity
evidence.note: Adult residence and literary activity in Lisbon; childhood in Durban is distinguished. Published literary criticism from1912, creative prose from1913 and poems from1914; participated in Portugal’s Modernist movement. Poetry, prose and literary criticism using distinct authorial heteronyms.

qualifications: No claim of contemporary worldwide recognition: much of his reputation developed after death.
